name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Persist post-deploy/preview flash messages in Postgres (keyed by channel slug) instead of Flask session, since AudioMuse's host app doesn't reliably issue session cookies for plugin routes.
Automated plugin release from CI after tests passed.
